data.title: Bitcoin’s Decade-Long Outperformance Over Stocks May Be Over, Chart Suggests
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC) has outperformed the stock market for years, but that changed after the S&P 500 (SPX) hit an all time high this week, while BTC remained in a drawdown. One long-term chart showed that stocks have now pulled ahead.The S&P 500-to-Bitcoin ratio, a metric used to show how much Bitcoin is…
